items.title: Thoughts on recent changes
items.summary:
This is basically what most of the community is saying now, but the most recent changes made (specifically regarding the new D zone [which is the main endgame mode] and the Corposant ‘bug’ fix), don’t seem to be necessary for game balance. While a decent shield from Corpo’s pilots might seem overpowered, this has been in the game for who knows how long (I don’t play discard so I wouldn’t know), and it still is fairly rare to see Corposant being as much as Gmurphy, Arachne, etc.

I’m might be biased since i couldn’t clear past Alert 4 for the previous D zone, but this new more seems to cater more to the whales, and especially to those who have access to turn rewinds. I really don’t think somebody who can’t do that will be resetting the stage a few hundred times to proc a 4% dr (trust me, I tried). And while Light made a statement saying that a few people were able to clear it on madness, you can tell that most (if not all) those clears used very specific counters for said stage, or use whaled units and/or turn rewind. Overall, this doesn’t seem like a great replacement for the previous D zone. I wish the old D zone would come back, and if the devs really want to add a harder difficulty, they could just add an Alert 6 for those who really want a challenge, instead of receiving such outrage from the player base over an unnecessary change (in my opinion). I lost a lot of motivation to do my dailies, as the new D zone doesn’t feels like the old one where I could try out different team comps more flexibly than this new one, where you now seem to be corralled into using specific units for cheese clears. I would’ve given this game a 5 star in the past, but I really dislike the changes to this new game mode. I hope this will be rectified in the future (though as this new mode and the Corpo ‘bug fix’ has been doubled down on l, I’m not feeling very hopeful going forward). The 100 ethereal cores were nice, but I don’t think that’s enough to make this a forgive and forget scenario.
